record.title: Validate native checkpoints for the remaining missing-device branch
record.intent: Test the entire SCU transport-failure LA region with precise stops and no new hardware responses.
requirements: Implement the fixed four-store ten-checkpoint hypothesis in docs/research/remaining-init-decision.md, pinning native instruction bytes bindings literals and mutable state against the recovered grammar.
Preserve existing ADC452 SPU8 and two synthetic identity reads, stock bytes and all established thread mapping and register guards.
Use one rotating per-thread hardware breakpoint only while main is stopped; clear and verify old debug state then set and verify next without single-stepping or changing general registers.
Continue only actual negative board and GPIO open results with false original bool and negative cached descriptor; verify exact propagated errors and stop successful opens before device I/O.
Accept SCU4004 operands80000000 and0 then LA7034 operands1 and0 at their exact phases; capture live shadows and stop before the next R32 offset4 or any divergence.

Privately test complete sequence atomic completion between checkpoints successful-open stops cached bool binding shadow operand order width thread checkpoint and timeout negatives; independently verify raw state and all cleanup.
Preserve existing regression controls and pin the exact tested executable; unexpected debug architecture behavior is a decision event rather than an assumed successful fixture.
No guest device-node change may force missing-device outcomes; no new synthetic read or transport result and no physical instrument access.
acceptance: Private positive or negative conclusion and tested executable hash are committed and pushed before stock continuation.
